# EditLayer

EditLayer is an open-source npm package that adds live in-page content editing to any Next.js website. It requires no CMS, no database, and no separate service. Editors log in via a magic link, click any editable field directly on the live page, type their changes, and hit Publish. Publishing commits a `content.json` file to the GitHub repository via the GitHub API. Vercel detects the push and redeploys automatically.

## Key facts

- Package name: `@editlayer/next`
- License: MIT (completely free, forever)
- Requires: Next.js 13+ with App Router, Vercel, GitHub
- No database, no hosted service, no vendor lock-in
- Authentication: magic-link (email + short-lived signed token, HTTP-only cookie session)
- Content storage: `editlayer/content.json` committed directly to your GitHub repo
- Roles: Owner (can publish), Editor (can save drafts only)
- Config: 4 environment variables (secret, site URL, Resend API key, GitHub token)

## How it works

1. Run `npm install @editlayer/next` and `npx editlayer init`. The CLI scaffolds API routes and a config file.
2. Wrap any hardcoded string with `<EditableText id="unique.field.id">` and keep all existing styles.
3. Add four env vars to Vercel: EDITLAYER_SECRET, EDITLAYER_SITE_URL, EDITLAYER_RESEND_API_KEY, EDITLAYER_GITHUB_TOKEN.
4. Push to GitHub. Vercel deploys.
5. Visit yoursite.com/?edit=true. Enter your email. Click the magic link. Green outlines appear on every editable field.
6. Click a field, edit inline, see a live preview. Save a draft or hit Publish to commit to GitHub. Vercel redeploys.

## Security model

- Origin validation on every API request
- Rate limiting on auth and publish endpoints
- Field ID allowlists (only pre-defined IDs can be written)
- Content sanitization (plain text only, no arbitrary HTML injection)
- HTTP-only cookies for sessions
- Editors cannot publish, only save drafts. Only owners can push live.

## Source and documentation

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@editlayer/next
- Setup guide: https://editlayer.dev/#setup
- FAQ: https://editlayer.dev/#faq
